leads.claim: The document mentions 'silver bodies' of high-flying U-2 aircraft catching the sun, which could be mistaken for fiery objects by observers below.
leads.why: The text explicitly identifies these 'silver bodies' as U-2 aircraft, explaining them as a prosaic reflection phenomenon rather than biological entities.

doc_verdict: This document is a historical account of the development of U-2 and A-12 reconnaissance aircraft and contains no information suggesting the government obtained or held physical material from a UAP or UFO.
